title: Reconcile challenge board
description: Run pnpm tsecbench status e1-02 and list; write evidence/tsec/board.json with unique_code, container_status, container_addr, scores.

title: Recon e1-02 entry
description: e1-02 is already started at the container_addr (VPN). HTTP recon the feedback/search site; save headers/body notes under evidence/tsec/recon-*.txt. Do not start extra containers unless this one is broken (then close+start).

title: Exploit XSS/session and submit flag
description: Authorized TSecBench e1-02 only. Bypass WAF on reflected input, steal user session / reach protected flag. Submit with: pnpm tsecbench submit e1-02 '<flag>'. Save API JSON to evidence/tsec/submit-*.json. Then pnpm tsecbench close e1-02. Avoid hint (costs score).
